trigger_condition: Approved preparation encounters a valid shared audit root without its audit mutex.
potential_consequence: Preparation reports success, but subsequent maintenance and upgrade reject the newly inherited mutex ACL.

trigger_condition: Audit log inherits both required ACEs but retains an untrusted file owner.
potential_consequence: The owner can change the DACL and rewrite audit records despite passing validation.

trigger_condition: Serial configuration changes while apply_alarm_reading awaits its database connection.
guard_snippet: await repository.apply_alarm_reading(..., expected_version=entry.config_version)  # Lock device; reject disabled/deleted/version drift within transaction.
potential_consequence: An obsolete sample can trigger alarms after disablement or against replacement configuration.
